site.title: Kotonoha — Wayland lyrics
site.description: Kotonoha: Wayland lyrics for any MPRIS player, with no player plugin required.
does.mpris: Any MPRIS player, no plugin required
does.mpris.body: Reads the track and position over D-Bus. Nothing is installed on the player side. Position is interpolated from a local clock instead of being polled every frame.
does.sources.body: Configure source order, matching, fallback and the local cache.
settings.title: Kotonoha Settings
does.through.body: When enabled, pointer events pass to the window underneath. The lyrics layer does not intercept clicks.
does.follow: Theme and language can follow the system
does.follow.body: Light, dark, or follow-system. Language can follow the system too. Both are on the first settings page and apply immediately.
does.layer.fullscreen.behavior: KDE/KWin and wlroots compositors float above fullscreen
does.layer.blur.behavior: Stays translucent; blur is disabled without either
does.layer.compatibility: Compatibility: Compositors without wlr-layer-shell, such as GNOME/Mutter, use a normal top-most window.
hero.title: Wayland desktop lyrics
hero.lead: Kotonoha reads MPRIS playback state over D-Bus and shows word-timed lyrics on a Wayland layer. Works with any MPRIS player. No player plugin required.
design.title:
The site looks like the program
because the values are the same file.
design.lead: None of the colour is taken twice — every value comes from theme.py and models.py. This page records the values, the components, and which rules can go red.
s.parts.lead: One role, one implementation. They are rendered side by side because that is the only way a drifted variant shows up.
s.search.lead: When there are many results, sort by clicking a header. Length uses seconds; match uses rank.
search.title: Search lyrics
search.lead: Find lyrics from different sources, then apply the selected version.
search.unavailable: Unavailable: two sources did not respond
get.arch.note: AUR package: kotonoha-git, built from the latest main commit.
get.nixos.note: Add it to your flake, then put the package in systemPackages.
get.source.note: Install system dependencies first. uv sync builds the native Wayland bridge.
foot.desc: Needs a Wayland compositor with wlr-layer-shell. KDE/KWin and wlroots compositors work.
get.lead: Gentoo via the gentoo-zh overlay, Arch via kotonoha-git on the AUR, or NixOS via a flake. Debian/Ubuntu can install the DEB; Fedora and other RPM-based systems can install the RPM, or you can build from source.
get.deb.note: The official Release provides an amd64 package; the command needs curl and jq.
get.rpm.note: The official Release provides an x86_64 package; the command needs curl and jq.
